summary: Radical Entertainment's alternate-sequel Scarface game, plus canceled follow-up efforts and a suspicious short-lived 2025 PC re-release attempt.

entries.title: Scarface: The World Is Yours
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version where legally owned

emulation.emulator: Native Windows, Dolphin, PCSX2, or xemu
emulation.notes: Use Windows if legally owned; Wii/Xbox/PS2 emulation is for version comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version with compatibility fixes

primary.version: PC version with reputable compatibility fixes where owned
primary.why: Scarface released for Windows, PlayStation 2, Xbox, and later Wii with enhanced graphics and Wii controls. Windows is the highest-fidelity route when legally owned and properly patched, while Wii is a console route with control/presentation tweaks but no sourced content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play a legally owned Windows copy with reputable compatibility fixes; avoid relying on the suspicious 2025 short-lived re-release unless ownership and file provenance are clear.

all_releases.fidelity: PC release; preservation-sensitive after a suspicious 2025 short-lived re-release was delisted.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route when legally owned and patched.

all_releases.fidelity: Wii version with enhanced graphics and Wii-specific controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: interesting console version but no sourced gameplay-content advantage over Windows.
skip: original route but lower practical fidelity than Windows.
skip: original route but lower practical fidelity than Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is the fidelity route; Wii's control/presentation changes do not create a required secondary content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Xbox 360 and sequel plans were canceled. The 2025 PC re-release attempt was quickly delisted and reported as suspicious, so it is not treated as a stable definitive edition.
